# Token reference

Every tier 2 (semantic) token and every component's tier 3 token. Tier 1 are the twelve `--rind-brand-*` inputs; see [white-label.md](white-label.md).

## Tier 2: semantic tokens

| Category | Tokens |
|---|---|
| border | `--rind-border-width` |
| color | `--rind-color-accent-border`, `--rind-color-accent-on-solid`, `--rind-color-accent-soft`, `--rind-color-accent-soft-hover`, `--rind-color-accent-solid`, `--rind-color-accent-solid-hover`, `--rind-color-accent-text`, `--rind-color-bg`, `--rind-color-border`, `--rind-color-border-strong`, `--rind-color-danger-border`, `--rind-color-danger-on-solid`, `--rind-color-danger-soft`, `--rind-color-danger-soft-hover`, `--rind-color-danger-solid`, `--rind-color-danger-solid-hover`, `--rind-color-danger-text`, `--rind-color-neutral-border`, `--rind-color-neutral-on-solid`, `--rind-color-neutral-soft`, `--rind-color-neutral-soft-hover`, `--rind-color-neutral-solid`, `--rind-color-neutral-solid-hover`, `--rind-color-neutral-text`, `--rind-color-overlay`, `--rind-color-success-border`, `--rind-color-success-on-solid`, `--rind-color-success-soft`, `--rind-color-success-soft-hover`, `--rind-color-success-solid`, `--rind-color-success-solid-hover`, `--rind-color-success-text`, `--rind-color-surface`, `--rind-color-surface-raised`, `--rind-color-text`, `--rind-color-text-disabled`, `--rind-color-text-muted`, `--rind-color-warning-border`, `--rind-color-warning-on-solid`, `--rind-color-warning-soft`, `--rind-color-warning-soft-hover`, `--rind-color-warning-solid`, `--rind-color-warning-solid-hover`, `--rind-color-warning-text` |
| duration | `--rind-duration-fast`, `--rind-duration-normal`, `--rind-duration-slow` |
| ease | `--rind-ease-in-out`, `--rind-ease-out` |
| focus | `--rind-focus-color`, `--rind-focus-offset`, `--rind-focus-width` |
| font | `--rind-font-mono`, `--rind-font-sans` |
| hit | `--rind-hit-area` |
| leading | `--rind-leading-normal`, `--rind-leading-tight` |
| radius | `--rind-radius-control`, `--rind-radius-full`, `--rind-radius-indicator`, `--rind-radius-lg`, `--rind-radius-md`, `--rind-radius-panel`, `--rind-radius-sm` |
| shadow | `--rind-shadow-key`, `--rind-shadow-key-pressed`, `--rind-shadow-lg`, `--rind-shadow-sm` |
| size | `--rind-size-lg`, `--rind-size-md`, `--rind-size-sm` |
| space | `--rind-space-1`, `--rind-space-2`, `--rind-space-3`, `--rind-space-4`, `--rind-space-6`, `--rind-space-8` |
| text | `--rind-text-lg`, `--rind-text-md`, `--rind-text-sm`, `--rind-text-xs` |
| tracking | `--rind-tracking-label`, `--rind-tracking-tight` |

## Runtime tokens

Written by rind-ui at run time (positioning, scroll lock, animation); readable, not themeable.

- `--rind-accordion-content-height`
- `--rind-accordion-content-width`
- `--rind-available-height`
- `--rind-available-width`
- `--rind-collapsible-content-height`
- `--rind-pop-from`
- `--rind-scrollbar-width`
- `--rind-transform-origin`
